breeds.name: Alaskan
breeds.description: A german rabbit breed created by a rabbit judge named Max Fischer with the goal of making a rabbit with similar looks to the Alaskan Fox. Instead, they ended up with this jet-black furred rabbit breed.

breeds.name: Belgian Hare
breeds.description: The breed responsible for launching the domestic rabbit industry. It was selectively bred to resemble wild European hares.

breeds.name: Californian
breeds.description: A breed developed for the fur and meat industries in 1923. They have dense, plush fur coats.

breeds.name: Mini Lop
breeds.description: Discovered at a German National Rabbit Show in 1972, mini lops have a small rounded body. They were previously called 'Klein Widders.'

breeds.name: Flemish Giant
breeds.description: The earliest records of this dog-sized breed are from roughly 1860. They make for docile pets.

breeds.name: Netherland Dwarf
breeds.description: The earliest Netherland Dwarfs had fearful, aggressive temperaments. Present day dwarfs instead have a gentle, friendly, and energetic disposition.

breeds.name: Rhinelander
breeds.description: Similar in appearance to the Checkered Giant, the Rhinelander has a trim athletic appearance.
